_comment: RU v3 photos until the Leonardo F01–F25 frames arrive (designer r2, 31.10.2026): a slot [КАДР Fxx] gets the first photo of its 'prefer' list (theme match, PLAN §8) not used yet on the page — hero included; every photo at most ONCE per page. No suitable photo (empty list: F13, F18, F19, F20) or all already used -> no image: the text block gets the 6 px basalt bar (--plinth, --cs-basalt). Alt texts: alts.json. focal = object-position of each photo in the mobile 4:5 hero crop (CSS class fp-<file>, CSP forbids style=). QA T3-11: F14 (котлован), F15 (каркас), F16 (кровля в монтаже) are construction stages; no photo shows one -> text block + basalt bar (decision 1). F17 (отделка): designer r3 (31.10.2026) — a finished-house photo is misleading, so F17 never gets a photo: on construccion it is a text block + basalt bar, on other pages the slot is hidden when the page already shows another photo (else text block + bar); build_v3.py F17_RULE.
